This 2,325 square foot facility
is the hub of the park and
off ers interpretive exhibits
reflecting our natural world,
including a life-sized oak tree and
animal home exhibit. Additionally,
there is a bird viewing area,
native fish aquariums, library and
hands-on learning station for kids.
Come enjoy the seasons with our
educational programs, events and
clubs. Make sure to visit the Nature
Discovery Trail (sensory trail and
nature playground) just north of
the Nature Center.
